path.data-label: Not yet met: The current collection and full authored document share the Glass desk with exact membership, stable identity, chosen reading size, protected input and a reliable return to the selected row. TST-0063 is walked with real-scale data, keyboard, reduced motion and the read-only narrow/tablet route. Historical fixed-navigator evidence below does not discharge this new criterion. Automated evidence, 2026-10-02: [[TST-0068-The-Glass-Desktop-Is-Walked-With-A-Real-Pointer]], [[TST-0069-The-Collection-Holds-Still-When-Notes-Change-On-Disk]] and [[TST-0072-Glass-Is-Measured-At-The-Size-Of-A-Real-Workspace]] are scripted walks with a real pointer and keyboard in a Linux box, the last on a copy of `your-trainer`, 3,269 notes. They cover membership, identity, the chosen size, the keyboard, reduced motion and the served page in a narrow window. Not ticked: [[TST-0063-A-Collection-And-Full-Note-Share-Glass]] is a person's walk and has not been walked, and no tablet was used.

path.data-label: Not yet met: The continuity repair in TASK-0104 satisfies ISS-0070/71/72 and the revised TST-0052: no duplicated spatial note or ghost, no size jump on movement, and the neighbourhood moves with its document. Automated evidence, 2026-10-02: the three issues are `fixed` on the smoke run's Glass section ([[TST-0045-Glass-Is-Driven-With-A-Real-Pointer]]) and the neighbourhood walk, whose checks are in [[TASK-0104-Preserve-Note-Identity-Size-And-Neighbourhood-While-Moving]]. Not ticked: [[TST-0052-A-Note-Opens-In-The-Middle-Of-Its-Neighbours-And-The-Wheel-Zooms]] is a person's walk and has not been walked. One choice in [[ISS-0072-Moving-The-Note-In-The-Middle-Throws-The-Arrangement-Away]] is Edwin's: a dragged document stops at the field's edge with its header in sight, where his answer of 2026-09-12 was that nothing is clamped.

path.data-label: Not yet met: FEAT-0023's scene and handoff contracts are decided and its eventual acceptance walk records restoration, fresh query membership and recovery from an unavailable display. Planned 2026-10-02: the contracts are proposed in ADR-0007 and not yet accepted by Edwin, the note is expanded, and the walk is [[TST-0073-A-Scene-Reopens-And-A-Note-Crosses-Screens]], unwalked. Built the same day. path.data-label: Not yet met: Deck opens a workspace in Glass: the owed notes are in front, the view's subject fills the middle and the outer field, and the quiet band is behind you. **Every note the view holds is in a band or counted on screen, and no band is silently short.** The walk is [[TST-0023-Glass-Opens-First-And-A-Days-Notes-Are-Read-In-It]]. Automated evidence, 2026-09-10: [[TST-0045-Glass-Is-Driven-With-A-Real-Pointer]] opens an address with no surface in Glass, with owed notes in front, the view either side and the quiet band on the canvas behind with its count on the compass. The walk is Edwin's.

path.data-label: Met: Switching view re-arranges the same cards, and no note is dropped into the quiet band because a nearer band was full: overflow is stated on screen. Evidence, 2026-09-10: [[TST-0045-Glass-Is-Driven-With-A-Real-Pointer]] (11 of 12 cards kept their elements across a switch and moved, none reused, no per-card delay) and [[TST-0040-The-Field-Deals-Every-View-Into-Three-Bands]] (every owed note in front or counted, Your Trainer's overflow counted); the bar says "and N more in front — all listed in the navigator".

path.data-label: Not yet met: Lifting a note brings its neighbourhood into the front band, the front plane says what it now means, and with two or more notes on the desk the field marks what they share. Automated evidence, 2026-09-10: [[TST-0045-Glass-Is-Driven-With-A-Real-Pointer]] (11 of 11 neighbours in front, the label, the owed count unmoved, the shared set marked and counted). The walk is Edwin's. **Amended 2026-09-11 ([[FEAT-0017-An-Opened-Note-Stands-In-The-Middle-Of-Its-Neighbours]]):** a lift first puts the note in the middle with its neighbourhood on a ring around it; the neighbourhood takes the front band once the note leaves the middle.

path.data-label: Not yet met: **Added 2026-09-10.** A person arranges the field by hand and it behaves as stated: a pulled note stands in the front band across a view switch, a pushed note is behind them, an owed note cannot be pushed out and the refusal says why, the front plane counts what a hand placed, panes keep their place and size across a restart while the pulled and pushed sets do not, and `git status` in the workspace is unchanged afterwards. The walk is [[TST-0038-The-Field-Is-Arranged-By-Hand-And-A-Note-Is-Thrown-To-Another-Screen]]. Automated evidence, 2026-09-10: [[TST-0045-Glass-Is-Driven-With-A-Real-Pointer]] (pull across a view switch, push, refused push with its sentence, the counts, panes across a reload, `git status` unchanged) and [[TST-0043-The-Hands-State-Is-Shared-And-Never-Kept]] (the sets are dropped on restart). The walk is Edwin's.

path.data-label: Not yet met: **Added 2026-09-10.** After a week of daily use in Glass, Edwin records from the compass how often he turned to look behind and whether anything was lost there. The DES-0002 review said this question should be a criterion rather than a remark, because the literature expects a "behind you" band to become a place things are forgotten, and pushing by hand makes that easier. Either answer is a result, and a bad one is what would retire the quiet band's placement, not the phase. Edwin's, after a week of use; nothing automated stands in for it.

path.data-label: Met: The frame time while turning is measured on the fleet's largest workspace in a foreground window and written as a number in [[FEAT-0009-The-Field-Where-Depth-Carries-Priority]], with the pooled-versus-canvas choice recorded beside it. If the number fails on a laptop, Spread returns to being the default and this note says so. Evidence, 2026-09-10: written in [[FEAT-0009-The-Field-Where-Depth-Carries-Priority]], "Measured": Your Trainer held the display's 16.7 ms median frame (17.0 ms at the 95th percentile) with two panes held and a reach drawn, 2.2 ms of script work per frame, 286 tiles and 2,303 elements at most, window in front; the hybrid is kept. Taken on a Mac Studio, not a laptop: the laptop reading is owed, and the throttled run (6.6 ms of work at 4× CPU cost) is an estimate.

path.data-label: Not yet met: [[FEAT-0001-The-Corpus-Has-An-Inside]]'s two other measurements are written as numbers: the size and time of the one request that returns the whole edge list, and the position drift when a note is added and the layout recomputed. A planted orphan and a single-edge cluster are visible in the orbit arrangement ([[TST-0025-A-Planted-Orphan-And-A-Single-Edge-Cluster-Are-Visible]]). A measurement that fails costs the orbit arrangement, not the field, and is recorded here as an outcome. The numbers are written, 2026-09-10, in [[FEAT-0001-The-Corpus-Has-An-Inside]], "Measured": the one request is 2.39 MB and 86 ms cold on the cockpit's 1,549 notes, and the drift when a note is added is 0 on every corpus. The orphan band and the bridge colour are built and [[TST-0047-The-Orbit-Layout-Is-Solved-Once-And-Kept]] finds a planted orphan and a planted cluster; the walk [[TST-0025-A-Planted-Orphan-And-A-Single-Edge-Cluster-Are-Visible]] is Edwin's.
